description:
**Dimension: separation-of-concerns · 3 findings (1 medium, 2 low)** — see report §separation-of-concerns. Scope narrowed 2026-08-07: the fourth finding (the `polar_transform*` naming leak) was split into `cdb951cc` so that `07a1813a` could depend on the rename alone.

- (med) `gf2-kernels-hip/Cargo.toml:24` — dev-deps on `gf2-algebra` AND `gf2-coding`, which depend on `gf2-kernels-hip` in production (two reversed test-layer edges). Relocate the cross-check/QAM tests to the crates where the reference types live.
- (low) `gf2-kernels-simd/Cargo.toml:34` — dev-dep on `gf2-algebra` inverts layer order; move Packed5/Packed7 cross-check proptests into `gf2-algebra`'s own suite.
- (low) `gf2-core/src/sparse.rs:558` — `deterministic_ldpc_like_fixture` embeds "ldpc" in a core `#[doc(hidden)]` export; rename to `deterministic_sparse_fixture`.

The dependency-direction findings are governed by @/inv/crate-dependency-direction.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The two reversed dev-dep edges (hip→algebra/coding, simd→algebra) removed by relocating the affected tests, OR explicitly justified in this issue if relocation is infeasible.
- [hard] REQ-02: `deterministic_ldpc_like_fixture` renamed to `deterministic_sparse_fixture`, all call sites updated.
- [hard] REQ-03: `cargo nextest --profile ci`, clippy, fmt pass; dependency graph free of the cited reversed edges.

## Notes

`gf2-kernels-simd` also carries a path dev-dependency on the non-workspace prototype `dev/research/f3_bipedal` (see the root `Cargo.toml` comment). That edge is deliberate and out of scope here.
title: Resolve reversed dev-dependency edges and core fixture naming
